summary: Dropbox, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a $400 million revolving credit facility (expandable to $500M) with JPMorgan as agent and several joint lead arrangers. The facility matures December 11, 2029, is guaranteed by material subsidiaries, secured by substantially all assets, and permits general corporate purposes including share repurchases. No amounts were drawn at closing. Interest is SOFR-based plus a margin tied to secured leverage. This is a routine debt financing arrangement, not a special-situation event. There is no transaction to watch or arbitrage angle.
